title: PathKGen: Pathology Knowledge Assisted MLLM for Explainable Histopathology
abstract: arXiv:2610.33691v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Whole Slide Image (WSI) analysis serves as the fundamental method for the clinical diagnosis of cancer in digital histopathology. Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have enabled state-of-the-art (SOTA) automated histopathology report generation. However, MLLMs reason purely through distributions encoded in their neural parameters, limiting the amount of knowledge and reasoning logic they can contain given the model scale. Their black-box reasoning poses another challenge to the human interpretation of intermediate reasoning. We address these issues by utilizing knowledge graphs to inject external structured knowledge for MLLMs to reason over, while making this reasoning component visible. translated_title: PathKGen：病理学知识辅助的多模态大语言模型用于可解释的组织病理学分析
translated_abstract: 全切片图像（WSI）分析是数字组织病理学中癌症临床诊断的基础方法。多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的最新进展使得最先进的自动化组织病理学报告生成成为可能。然而，MLLM纯粹通过编码在其神经参数中的分布进行推理，在给定模型规模的条件下，这限制了它们所能容纳的知识量和推理逻辑。其黑盒推理方式也对人类理解中间推理过程构成了另一个挑战。我们通过利用知识图谱为MLLM注入外部结构化知识以供其推理，同时使这一推理组件可视化，来解决上述问题。知识图谱能够部分外化医学知识的承载，而这一方向在病理报告生成领域仍未被充分探索。我们提出了PathKGen，一种用于组织病理学的知识图谱辅助的多模态大语言模型。
tldr: 提出PathKGen，一种利用知识图谱为多模态大语言模型注入外部结构化病理知识并使推理过程可视化的方法，从而实现可解释的自动化组织病理学报告生成。
en_tdlr: PathKGen is a knowledge graph-assisted MLLM that injects external structured pathology knowledge and makes the reasoning component visible, enabling explainable automated histopathology report generation.
